story: Mia and Sam live in a big city. They walk to the centre of the town to visit a post office. Sam wants to send a postcard to an Australian friend in London. They see many tall buildings and a green park in this area. After their walk, they go back to their flat.
title: A Day in the City
setting: A busy city street with tall buildings and a park.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: a young girl with short black hair and a red sweater

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: a young boy with brown hair and a blue jacket

sentences.en: Mia and Sam live in a big city.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a girl with short black hair and a red sweater, and Sam, a boy with brown hair and a blue jacket, stand in a busy city.

sentences.en: This city is much larger than their village.
sentences.zh: 这个城市比他们的村庄大得多。
sentences.scene_prompt: A view of a large city with many buildings next to a small green village.

sentences.en: They walk to the centre of the town.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam walk toward the middle of a busy town square.

sentences.en: Sam wants to visit the post office.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam and Mia stand in front of a building with a sign that shows a letter.

sentences.en: He sends a postcard to London.
sentences.zh: 他寄了一张明信片去伦敦。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam holds a colorful postcard in his hands.

sentences.en: An Australian friend will receive it.
sentences.zh: 一位澳大利亚朋友会收到它。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture of a friendly person in Australia looking at a postcard.

sentences.en: The area has many tall buildings.
sentences.zh: 这个地区有很多高大的建筑物。
sentences.scene_prompt: A view of many tall buildings in a city area.

sentences.en: People build many houses in this area.
sentences.zh: 人们在这个地区建造许多房屋。
sentences.scene_prompt: Workers are building a new house in a city area.

sentences.en: They see a green park near the street.
sentences.zh: 他们在街道附近看到一个绿色的公园。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam look at a green park with trees next to a street.

sentences.en: Finally, they go to their flat.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们回到了他们的公寓。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam walk toward the door of a modern apartment building.
